evidence: The functional product shell supports skip-to-content, Ctrl+K command focus, Ctrl+/ shortcut help, Alt+H home focus, theme control, visible focus, dialog focus containment, Escape dismissal with focus restoration, accessible names, and a polite live region without a pointer.
The Chromium product replay reports no critical violations, zero network requests, two responsive cases, and one CAP-01 product page with no UI-reference pages.

Tauri frontendDist targets product-dist only. The full 34-document/32-page reference package is built separately into dist solely for governed conformance verification and cannot be served as the product entry point.

The 34-test desktop suite covers product success and denial boundaries including reference-route exclusion, exact product inventory, manifest/input drift, unsafe network surfaces, focus behavior, output separation, and performance provenance.

The application unit suite covers normal shortcuts plus editable-target suppression, dialog cycling/restoration, command focus, theme persistence, and rendering boundaries; the browser aggregate replays the compiled production bundle.

Desktop build, workspace, Tauri, UI package, documentation, verification, performance, generated-output, and audit-checkout contracts are updated together with exact inventories and no native privilege expansion.

Repository documentation now states that design/ui-reference is a design and conformance authority only: mock data, future routes, illustrative content, and nonfunctional actions must never ship as the product.
The root pnpm dev wrapper continues to select the repository-pinned Node 24/Corepack runtime in cmd.exe, PowerShell, and Git Bash without launching a separate reference application.

reviewerDisposition.note: Independent review must verify pointer-free keyboard and focus behavior in the compiled product, screen-reader naming/live-region semantics, the exact product/reference boundary, denial of reference-only pages and network access, evidence identities, and the complete desktop profile before approval.
